mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is currently 50 degrees with overcast skies near Fireman's Park, and we are under a Waning Crescent moon.
The City of Verona recently adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-range roadmap for housing, transportation, and sustainability through the next decade.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and Puppets in the Park tomorrow.
Regarding the weekly police report, on October 3, an officer located and arrested a 19-year-old Verona man who was a felon in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop.
Today's delicious flavor is OREO Cookie Overload, and you can head over to grab a scoop when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
